newsitem.title: USA: Excel says Illinois hog plant up after brief delay.
newsitem.headline: Excel says Illinois hog plant up after brief delay.

text.p: Hog slaughter was proceeding after a two-hour shutdown early Wednesday due to water problems at a Beardstown, Ill., plant operated by Excel Corp, a division of Cargill Inc, a company spokesman said.
The plant went down at about 0830 CDT and came back up at about 1030 CDT, said Mark Klein, public relations director.
"They had just detected a slight discoloration in the water, so they stopped production so they could flush the system out and get USDA approval to resume," Klein said.
The plant operates two slaughter shifts, he added.
Klein declined to give daily capacity for the plant but industry sources put hog slaughter capacity there at 16,000 head.
